ECLIPSE

Geometry of light. Packaging with a sense of depth.

VISUAL IDEA

Design,
assembled in volume.

A dark violet palette makes the luminous geometry of the chandelier the focal point. The product image comes first, followed by the name and specifications.

A fine geometric pattern connects the box faces. A contrasting band separates the category from the product image, with technical information on the reverse.
